about: The UI principles the game is audited against, in rank order. scripts/ui-audit.mjs reads this file; design-v3/ui-audit/README.md says how the loop runs. standing: established = a published standard, inferred = our reading of genre practice with a threshold we set. checks: test = a headless test under sketches/core-loop/tests, lint = an npm script, capture = a still tool under sketches/core-loop/tools (needs a display), review = a blind read of a still. gap is what no check holds yet.

principles.name: The threat reads first
principles.rule: Nothing hides a danger, including its own warning, and the warning comes early enough to act on.
principles.source: Genre practice; LEGIBILITY.md sections 1 and 2; Andrew, 13 Nov 2026, on attack marks that hide the attack
principles.gap: Mark cover is read off stills by hand; no score with a pass line.

principles.name: Colour never works alone
principles.rule: Every fact a colour carries also has a shape, an icon, a pattern or a place.
principles.source: WCAG 2.2 1.4.1; Game Accessibility Guidelines (basic); Xbox Accessibility Guideline 103
principles.gap: Close pairs with no second carrier named, and one colour that carries two facts (the open P2 rows in UI-FINDINGS.tsv).

principles.name: Words and marks hold contrast
principles.rule: 4.5 to 1 for words, 3 to 1 for edges and marks.
principles.gap: HUD words and marks drawn over the live world have no measure; it needs stills of each stage's ground.

principles.name: Text is readable on the smallest screen
principles.rule: 18 px or more at 1080p, 9 px or more on a Steam Deck.
principles.source: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 101 (PC: 18 px at 1080p); Steam Deck compatibility review (9 px minimum, 12 px recommended, at 1280x800)
principles.gap: No text size setting. Text drawn by presentation scripts outside src/ui, or sized by its own arithmetic as the keycap letters were (UF-05), is not on the scale.

principles.name: Every input answers at once
principles.rule: A press shows on screen or in sound within 100 ms.
principles.gap: No measure. Needs a PC capture of press-to-first-change per verb and per menu.

principles.name: Everything works on a pad and focus is always visible
principles.rule: Every control can be reached and worked with the stick, and the focused one shows a ring.
principles.source: WCAG 2.2 2.1.1 and 2.4.7; Xbox Accessibility Guidelines 112 and 113
principles.gap: No check that every focusable control on every screen is reachable from the first focus.

principles.name: Targets are big enough
principles.rule: 44 px or more on the real screen.
principles.gap: Held only when stills are taken: ui_capture lists every small control, and no headless test does.

principles.name: Motion is optional and nothing flashes fast
principles.rule: Less motion and fewer flashes are settings; no more than three flashes a second.
principles.source: WCAG 2.2 2.3.1 and 2.3.3; Xbox Accessibility Guidelines 117 and 118
principles.gap: Flash rate is not measured against three a second.

principles.name: No fact arrives by sound alone
principles.rule: Every sound cue the player must act on has a visible twin.
principles.source: Game Accessibility Guidelines (basic); Xbox Accessibility Guideline 103
principles.gap: No list of act-on-it sound cues and their visible twins.

principles.name: Marks before words, one name for one thing
principles.rule: LEGIBILITY.md section 13: the carrier order and the S and W patterns.

checks.ref: S1 to S7, W3, W5, W8, W9 by a reviewer and a blind read of a still

principles.name: The HUD stays quiet
principles.rule: It shows what matters now; nothing talks over a fight.

principles.name: Menus are consistent and forgiving
principles.rule: One way back, a confirm only where something is lost, the same control in the same place.
